title: `menu select=0 interactive` — zshrs descends one directory level further than zsh

observed.notes: zsh stops at /usr/share/zsh/ and offers 5.9/ and site-functions/; zshrs has already accepted 5.9/ and is listing inside it. The round-2 shrinker proved this is not edit-related — it reduced to zero edit tokens, and it reproduces here with no edit program at all. Geometry pinned at 24x80, the geometry it was found at.

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)

zsh_binary.note: Homebrew zsh 5.9.2, which is what `zsh` on PATH resolves to here; /bin/zsh is an older build and is NOT what any harness runs.

confirmed.note: round 6 re-confirmation, from the full gate run in tests/compsys_fixtures/last_gate.json. What that run established: verdict STILL-DIVERGES; the harness's own detail was '2 row(s) differ'; failure fingerprint cc5fb00f9b, unchanged

history.note: all three harness files had uncommitted edits when this was confirmed (three agents were editing them concurrently); the sha256 prefixes above pin the exact bytes used.
